newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka retains early gains to end firmer.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka retains early gains to end firmer.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained early gains to end firmer against the U.S. currency in interbank trading on Wednesday as dollar demand remained modest.
Taka finished at 43.7500/7550 to the dollar against a previous close at 43.7650/7700.
The local unit opened at 43.7500/7600 per dollar and gained ground further. Call money was traded at 7.5 to 8.5 percent, slightly up from the previous seven to eight percent.
